title: We built an AI-native 3D editor, just dropped our launch video, would love your thoughts
author: Pradyumgg
selftext:
Been working on this for a while and finally feel ready to share it here.

Mixar is a standalone 3D editor (Blender fork) with an AI agent built in, not an add-on, not a plugin. The idea is that the full workflow lives in one place: PBR generation, image-to-3D, segment-to-3D, blockout-to-render, UV unwrapping — all handled or assisted by AI.

We just posted our launch video on X: [Post](https://x.com/mixie3D/status/2057460277130760501?s=20)

Curious what this community thinks, especially on the agentic side of things. Happy to answer questions in the comments.
